summary: Frontend-only QA of new delete flows for tournaments/clubs/teams. All requested scenarios PASS. (1) Super Admin on /admin: exactly 3 tournament cards present (la-serie-a-dei-bambini, torneo-degli-amici, future-cup-weekend), each with tournament-card-delete-<slug>. Clicking tournament-card-delete-future-cup-weekend opens window.prompt 'Eliminazione DEFINITIVA di «Future Cup Weekend»…'; entering wrong name 'no' → toast 'Nome non corrispondente: eliminazione annullata' and the card REMAINS. Right name was deliberately NEVER confirmed (preserving data). (2) Director on /admin: 0 tournament-card-delete-* buttons rendered (correctly hidden for non-super-admin). (3) Società flow (future-cup-weekend, tid 6a9b5b045d9e0985643d0aed): 'Nuova società' → clubs-create-button → club-name-input='QA Elimina' → club-create-submit → toast 'Società creata'; click club-delete-qa-elimina → native confirm 'Eliminare la società «QA Elimina»…' → accept → toast 'Società eliminata', row disappears. (4) La Serie A dei Bambini (tid 6a9b5b045d9e0985643d0a9f) Società: 26 club-delete-* buttons visible; attempting club-delete-academy-tuscolana returns 409 and toast 'La società ha 1 squadre iscritte: elimina prima le squadre dalla pagina Rose'; club row stays. (5) Rose flow in Future Cup Weekend: created club 'QA Rosa' + registered team via club-add-team-qa-rosa → team-competition-select (native select, first option) → team-create-submit → toast 'Squadra iscritta'. On /admin/t/<fcw>/rose, team auto-selected, clicked roster-delete-team-button → confirm 'Eliminare «QA Rosa 2016»…' → toast 'Squadra «QA Rosa 2016» eliminata'; the team disappears from roster-team-select (0 options after). (6) Rose flow in La Serie A dei Bambini: roster-team-select is a native <select>; selected 'Sporting Eur 2014' (value 6a9b5b045d9e0985643d0ab3) → roster-delete-team-button → confirm → toast 'La squadra ha 6 gare giocate o in corso: non può essere eliminata'; team remains in select. (7) Cleanup: 'QA Rosa' club (now 0 teams) deleted via club-delete-qa-rosa → toast 'Società eliminata'. Data left clean. The 3 production tournaments were never deleted.

issues: React hydration warning: <option> cannot contain a <span> child inside team-competition-select (native <select>). Caused by Visual-Editor instrumentation wrapping option text in <span data-ve-dynamic='true'>. Non-blocker but should be addressed by excluding native <option> contents from the VE wrapper or switching to a Radix Select.

action_items: (nice-to-have) Suppress VE <span> injection inside native <option> elements (Clubs.jsx line 170) to remove the React hydration warning when opening 'Nuova squadra'.

(nice-to-have) Consider replacing window.prompt (tournament delete) and window.confirm (club/team delete) with the project's Dialog component for consistent styling and better a11y, and to allow testing without page.on('dialog').
critical_code_review_comments: Tournament delete guard is purely client-side (window.prompt + string compare). Backend DELETE /tournaments/{tid} should also require a confirmation payload (e.g. {confirm_name: <slug>}) to protect against direct API calls. Please verify server-side guard exists in /app/backend/app/routers/tournaments.py.

409 messages for clubs/teams are localized and clear ('… squadre iscritte', '… gare giocate o in corso'). Good UX. Ensure the backend returns a structured error code too (e.g. detail='club_has_teams') for future i18n.
Director correctly cannot see tournament-level delete buttons on /admin, matching role separation (super_admin only).
